info.title: currencyapi
info.description: The currency APIs help you retrieve exchange rates and convert prices between currencies easily.

post.summary: Get a list of available currencies and corresponding countries
post.description: Enumerates available currencies and the countries that correspond to these currencies.

post.summary: Converts a price from the source currency into the destination currency
post.description: Automatically converts the price in the source currency into the destination currency using the latest available currency exchange rate data.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Source currency three-digit code (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Destination currency three-digit code (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

parameters.name: sourcePrice
parameters.description: Input price, such as 19.99 in source currency

post.summary: Gets the exchange rate from the source currency into the destination currency
post.description: Automatically gets the exchange rate from the source currency into the destination currency using the latest available currency exchange rate data.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Source currency three-digit code (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Destination currency three-digit code (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

AvailableCurrencyResponse.description: Result of performing an enumerate currencies operation

Currencies.description: List of available currencies from the API

ISOCurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency three-letter code associated with the country

IsEuropeanUnionMember.description: True if this country is currently a member of the European Union (EU), false otherwise

ConvertedCurrencyResult.description: Result of performing a Convert Currency operation

ConvertedPrice.description: The converted price in the destination currency

ISOCurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency three-letter code of destination price

FormattedPriceAsString.description: Formatted price in the destination currency as a string

ExchangeRateResult.description: Result of performing a get exchange rate operation

ExchangeRate.description: The exchange rate from the source to the destination currency
